biography_english:
A Galgastani who led a band of pirates that plagued the Obero Sea. He was born in one of the poorer quarters of Port Asyton, and spent his youth serving in a local tavern. There he became acquainted with the notorious pirate Lontera, and later joined his crew. When Lontera was executed by the Valerian army, Darza took the helm in his stead.
  His wife Veldrei was born to nobility, but became a pirate after Darza raided the vessel on which she had taken passage near Boed Fortress. Veldrei stayed ashore to watch over their den at Ndamsa Fortress after learning she carried Darza's child.
  Darza attacked members of the Liberation Front at Qadriga Fortress, commandeering their ship and cargo. However, before he could escape he was killed by Sir Folcurt and {hero}, who had arrived to free the hostages.
biography_spanish:
Un galgastani que lideraba una banda pirata que asolaba el mar de Obero. Nacio en un barrio pobre de Port Asyton y sirvio de joven en una taberna local. Alli conocio al infame pirata Lontera y luego se unio a su tripulacion. Cuando el ejercito valeriano ejecuto a Lontera, Darza tomo el mando.
  Su esposa Veldrei era noble, pero se hizo pirata cuando Darza asalto el barco en el que viajaba cerca de la Fortaleza de Boed. Veldrei se quedo en tierra cuidando su guarida en la Fortaleza de Ndamsa tras saber que esperaba un hijo suyo.
  Darza ataco al Frente de Liberacion en la Fortaleza de Qadriga, tomando su nave y carga. Sin embargo, antes de huir fue abatido por sir Folcurt y {hero}, quienes acudieron a liberar a los rehenes.

biography_english: A Galgastani who served his clan in battle. Sir Hektor was among the Galgastani taken prisoner after Coritanae Keep fell to the Resistance. He was pressed for information regarding remaining Balbatos loyalists, but steadfastly refused to speak. He was eventually slain at Almorica Castle.
biography_spanish: Un galgastani que sirvio a su clan en batalla. Sir Hektor estuvo entre los galgastani apresados tras caer el Castillo de Coritanae ante la Resistencia. Le exigieron informacion sobre los leales a Balbatos, pero rehuso hablar. Al final fue abatido en el Castillo de Almorica.

biography_english:
A Galgastani who served his clan in battle. He was a knight of House Didarro, a family of note in Coritanae. They have served the Lord of Coritanae for many generations, and are fiercely loyal to the Kingdom of Galgastan. Hektor was to wed Moldova until she fell in battle at Krysaro.
  He was garrisoned at Brigantys Castle under High Commander Xaebos, but later set off for the Bahanna Highlands to aid Moldova's sister, Cressida. He escorted Cressida to Brigantys Castle safely, but was then killed by the Order of {order}.
biography_spanish:
Un galgastani que sirvio a su clan en batalla. Era caballero de la Casa Didarro, ilustre familia de Coritanae. Sirvieron al lord de Coritanae por generaciones y son muy leales al Reino de Galgastan. Hektor iba a casarse con Moldova hasta que ella cayo en batalla en Krysaro.
  Estaba en el Castillo de Brigantys al mando del gran comandante Xaebos, pero partio a las alturas de Bahanna para ayudar a la hermana de Moldova, Cressida. Llevo a Cressida a salvo al Castillo de Brigantys, pero fue abatido por la Orden de {order}.

biography_english:
A Galgastani who served his clan in battle. At the start of the war he led a group of bandits based in the Phorampa Wildwood, but a desire to defend his homeland prompted him to enlist as a man-at-arms.
  Though an experienced fighter, he lacked an understanding of the art of warfare, and was often mocked by other soldiers. In an attempt to prove himself he led an offensive against partisans at Almorica Castle. However, his poor reputation was only compounded when he was slain by those he sought to bring to justice. He met his end at the hands of {hero}, the Hero of Golyat himself.
biography_spanish:
Un galgastani que sirvio a su clan en batalla. Al inicio de la guerra lidero un grupo de bandidos en el Bosque de Phorampa, pero el deseo de defender su patria lo llevo a alistarse como combatiente.
  Aunque era un luchador experto, carecia de comprension del arte de la guerra y otros soldados solian burlarse de el. En un intento por probar su valia, lidero una ofensiva contra partisanos en el Castillo de Almorica. Sin embargo, su mala reputacion empeoro al ser abatido por quienes buscaba llevar ante la justicia. Encontro su fin a manos de {hero}, el mismisimo heroe de Golyat.

biography_english: A Bakram who belonged to a special detachment sent to the Palace of the Dead at Regent Morne's behest to search for draconic magic. Born to a family of poisoners, she was well versed in the use of toxins and venoms. Her detachment included many such sages and masters of arcane lore, their task being the recovery of rare and legendary artifacts. She was killed in a clash with Resistance forces below the palace.
biography_spanish: Una bakram que pertenecia a un destacamento especial enviado al Palacio de los Muertos por orden del regente Morne para buscar magia draconica. Nacida en una familia de envenenadores, dominaba el uso de toxinas y venenos. Su destacamento incluia sabios y maestros del saber arcano para recuperar artefactos raros y legendarios. Fue abatida en un choque con fuerzas de la Resistencia bajo el palacio.
